# Model family registry

<!-- Generated by scripts/family_registry.py render from families.json; do not edit by hand. -->

Each family records its executable route, code status and evidence layer separately.
`configurable` means a reviewed config compiler exists; `template` means a reviewed `[[init]]`
template or external project driver is required; `doc_only` means the skill has guidance but
no executable entry. Evidence values: `pass`, `readback` (archived outputs read and redrawn,
no fresh estimation), `pending`, `—` (not started), `n/a`; `*` means the family section below
states a limit on that evidence.

For changing data sources or variables, follow
[the source and variable swap contract](family-source-swap-contract.md).

| Family | Code | Routes | Synthetic compile | Native synthetic | Real-data swap | Historical replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| APIM | configurable | apim_v2_config, apim_v1_config, template_bundle, archived_replay | pass | pass* | pending* | pass* |
| APIMeM | configurable | apim_v2_config, apim_v1_config, template_bundle, archived_replay | pass | pass* | pending* | pass* |
| APIMoM | configurable | apim_v2_config, apim_v1_config, template_bundle, archived_replay | pass | pass* | — | pass* |
| APIMeMoM | configurable | apim_v2_config, template_bundle, archived_replay | pass | pass* | — | pass* |
| MED | none | template_bundle | — | — | — | pending* |
| MOD | none | template_bundle | — | — | — | pending* |
| MODMED | none | template_bundle | — | — | — | pending* |
| LPA_LCA | doc_only | mplus_object_syntax, template_bundle | pass* | — | — | readback |
| LTA | doc_only | mplus_object_syntax, template_bundle | pass* | — | — | readback |
| MS_LTA | doc_only | mplus_object_syntax, template_bundle | pass* | — | — | readback |
| PP_LGCM | doc_only | external_project, template_bundle | —* | — | pending* | pending |
| OTHER_GROWTH | template | mplus_object_mapping | — | — | — | n/a |

- Data formats: csv, dta, archived_dat
- Route `apim_v2_config`: `scripts/apim_v2_config.R:plan_apim_workflow`, `scripts/apim_v2_runtime.R:run_apim_workflow_v2`
